question: Does God know and value me?
truth: You are a beloved child of God with eternal worth.
title: God Knows and Loves You
speaker: Alan T. Phillips
summary: Your worth does not depend on success, appearance, or the approval of others. Heavenly Father knows you personally, Jesus Christ offers redemption and relief, and your identity as a child of God gives lasting purpose to your life.
application: Write one sentence describing what being a child of God means to you.

question: Why am I here?
truth: Your life has divine purpose, even when you cannot yet see the whole plan.
title: Your Divine Nature and Eternal Destiny
speaker: Dale G. Renlund
summary: You came to earth with divine identity and eternal potential. Remembering who you are helps you make choices based on God's plan rather than temporary pressure, comparison, or fear.
application: Choose one decision today that reflects your divine identity.

question: Why is Jesus Christ central to everything?
truth: Jesus Christ is not merely part of the answer—He is the answer.
title: The Answer Is Always Jesus Christ
speaker: Russell M. Nelson
summary: Jesus Christ is the center of Heavenly Father's plan. Through His teachings, Atonement, Resurrection, and covenant power, we receive forgiveness, healing, direction, peace, and the hope of eternal life.
application: Ask yourself how you can place Jesus Christ more fully at the center of today.

question: Can Jesus Christ really help with my burdens?
truth: Jesus Christ is not an added burden; He is the source of relief.
title: Jesus Christ Is Not Our Burden; He Is Our Relief
speaker: David J. Wunderli
summary: Following Jesus Christ does not mean carrying every burden alone. The Savior offers strength, rest, and relief as we come to Him and allow His grace to support us through difficult seasons.
application: Name one burden in prayer and consciously place it in the Savior's hands.

question: Can I change after making mistakes?
truth: Because of Jesus Christ, your past does not have to determine your future.
title: Jesus Christ and Your New Beginning
speaker: Patrick Kearon
summary: The Savior offers more than one chance to begin again. Through repentance and His Atonement, setbacks, weakness, and sin can become turning points instead of permanent definitions of who you are.
application: Take one honest step toward repentance instead of waiting to feel perfect.

question: Do I have to be perfect before God can help me?
truth: Worthiness is faithful direction, not flawless performance.
title: Worthiness Is Not Flawlessness
speaker: Bradley R. Wilcox
summary: God does not expect immediate perfection. Through the grace of Jesus Christ, we can repent, improve, and continue growing while still receiving divine help along the way.
application: Replace one thought of failure with one faithful next step.

question: How can I find peace when life is still difficult?
truth: Peace comes through Jesus Christ, not through perfect circumstances.
title: Finding Personal Peace
speaker: Henry B. Eyring
summary: The Savior's peace can enter our hearts before our circumstances improve. As we receive His peace, we become better able to calm fear, strengthen others, and carry hope into troubled situations.
application: Pause and ask the Savior to help you feel peace before asking Him to change the problem.

question: What should I do when anxiety or conflict surrounds me?
truth: Prayer may not remove every storm immediately, but it brings divine support within it.
title: Prayers for Peace
speaker: Henry B. Eyring
summary: Turning sincerely and repeatedly to Heavenly Father brings peace and abiding support. Prayer helps us place our fear before God, recognize His presence, and move forward with greater spiritual steadiness.
application: Offer one unhurried prayer and speak honestly about what you are carrying.

question: How does God guide me personally?
truth: God guides us through the Holy Ghost as we seek, recognize, and act.
title: Promptings of the Spirit
speaker: Gary E. Stevenson
summary: Personal revelation becomes clearer as we invite the Holy Ghost, recognize spiritual impressions, and act faithfully on what we receive. Guidance often grows through small moments of obedience.
application: Act on one good prompting today instead of dismissing it.

question: How can I avoid confusing my own wishes with revelation?
truth: Revelation works within God's truth, commandments, and appointed order.
title: A Framework for Personal Revelation
speaker: Dale G. Renlund
summary: The Holy Ghost gives real personal guidance, but revelation does not contradict God's commandments or assign authority that belongs to someone else. Humility, scripture, prayer, and obedience help protect us from deception.
application: Compare an important impression with scripture and established gospel truth.

question: How can I remain faithful during overwhelming trials?
truth: Faith in Jesus Christ creates spiritual steadiness before the storm is over.
title: Steady in the Storms
speaker: Henry B. Eyring
summary: Life's storms test our spiritual foundation. We remain steady by becoming humble, relying on Jesus Christ, remembering God's promises, and continuing faithful practices when circumstances feel uncertain.
application: Keep one spiritual habit today even if you do not feel immediate results.

question: What can I hold onto when I feel discouraged?
truth: Hope in Christ sees beyond the pain of the present moment.
title: The Triumph of Hope
speaker: Neil L. Andersen
summary: Hope in Jesus Christ is more than wishing for easier circumstances. It is confidence that His promises are real, His Resurrection is certain, and His peace can sustain us while answers are still unfolding.
application: Write one reason you can still hope because of Jesus Christ.

question: How should followers of Christ treat other people?
truth: True discipleship is revealed most clearly in how we treat one another.
title: Peacemakers Needed
speaker: Russell M. Nelson
summary: Followers of Jesus Christ reject contention, cruelty, and personal attacks. Peacemaking requires courage, self-control, charity, and the willingness to respond in the Savior's way—especially when emotions are strong.
application: Choose one conversation today in which you will respond with greater patience.

question: How can one ordinary person make a meaningful difference?
truth: The Savior can multiply a willing offering, even when it feels small.
title: Here Am I, Send Me
speaker: Susan H. Porter
summary: Like the child who offered loaves and fishes, we do not need wealth, influence, or extraordinary ability to serve. Jesus Christ can magnify sincere efforts and use them to bless more people than we can see.
application: Offer one small act of service without waiting to feel fully prepared.

question: What should guide the choices I make today?
truth: An eternal perspective gives greater meaning to daily decisions.
title: Think Celestial!
speaker: Russell M. Nelson
summary: Daily decisions shape eternal direction. When we remember Jesus Christ, covenant promises, and our ultimate destination, temporary pressure loses some of its power and faithful choices become clearer.
application: Before one decision today, ask which choice leads you closer to Jesus Christ.
